msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia jaspe-art-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of tubes of acrylic paint in pink, purple and blue with a palette knife and paint swatches from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia jaspe-art-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a set of acrylic paint tubes, no labels from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia jaspe-art-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a blank stretched cotton canvas and a jar of white gesso from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a professional watercolour paint set in a metal tin with a brush from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia jaspe-art-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of three illustrated hardcover sketchbooks from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
